name: AE project edit manual smoke closeout report schema
purpose: Sanitized report shape for closing a human-operated AE smoke step without embedding project payloads or claiming an automated AE oracle.

report.approval_receipt_id: string or null; null in generated template and required when operator_filled
report.request_pair_manifest_digest: metadata-only sha256-v1 digest copied from request-pair manifest binding.cryptographic_digest.digest_hex; must match the reviewed manifest
report.request_pair_manifest_binding_algorithm: fnv1a64-v1-noncryptographic in the current adapter output
report.request_pair_manifest_binding_checksum: metadata-only checksum copied from the reviewed request-pair manifest binding block
report.source_project_path: reviewed source path or local copy path; must not be overwritten
report.output_project_path: explicit output_project.path reviewed before manual execution
report.source_overwrite_observed: boolean; must be false for an acceptable closeout

tool_generated_template.request_pair_manifest_digest: copied from request-pair manifest binding.cryptographic_digest.digest_hex when available

validator_report.approval_receipt_review_packet_status: copied from prerequisite_reports.review_packet_status when an approval receipt is supplied; must be review_ready for accepted closeout
validator_report.approval_receipt_review_packet_report_re: copied from prerequisite_reports.review_packet_report_reviewed when an approval receipt is supplied; must be true for accepted closeout
validator_report.approval_receipt_review_packet_binding_a: copied from prerequisite_reports.review_packet_binding_algorithm when an approval receipt is supplied; must match the review packet report binding algorithm
validator_report.approval_receipt_review_packet_binding_c: copied from prerequisite_reports.review_packet_binding_checksum when an approval receipt is supplied; must match the review packet report binding checksum
validator_report.approval_receipt_review_packet_digest_al: copied from prerequisite_reports.review_packet_digest_algorithm when an approval receipt is supplied; must match the review packet report digest algorithm
validator_report.approval_receipt_review_packet_digest_he: copied from prerequisite_reports.review_packet_digest_hex when an approval receipt is supplied; must match the review packet report cryptographic digest
validator_report.approval_receipt_generated_jsx_artifact_: copied from prerequisite_reports.generated_jsx_artifact_verification_report_reviewed when an approval receipt is supplied; must be true when the review packet includes supplemental generated JSX transaction artifact verification evidence
validator_report.approval_receipt_export_artifact_manifes: copied from prerequisite_reports.export_artifact_manifest_reviewed when an approval receipt is supplied; must match whether the review packet includes supplemental export artifact manifest evidence
validator_report.approval_receipt_export_artifact_verific: copied from prerequisite_reports.export_artifact_verification_report_reviewed when an approval receipt is supplied; must match whether the review packet includes supplemental export artifact verification evidence
validator_report.approval_receipt_aepx_preservation_proof: copied from prerequisite_reports.aepx_preservation_proof_reviewed when an approval receipt is supplied; must match whether the review packet includes supplemental synthetic AEPX preservation proof evidence

accepted_requires: manual_smoke_status is manual_smoke_completed
template_status is operator_filled
approval receipt artifact is present
review packet report artifact is present
approval_status is approved
approval receipt prerequisite_reports.review_packet_status is review_ready
approval receipt prerequisite_reports.review_packet_report_reviewed is true
approval receipt prerequisite_reports.review_packet_binding_checksum matches the supplied review packet report binding checksum
approval receipt prerequisite_reports.review_packet_digest_hex matches the supplied review packet report cryptographic digest
when the review packet includes supplemental generated JSX transaction artifact verification evidence, the approval receipt reviewed acknowledgement matches that packet
when the review packet includes supplemental standalone export manifest or artifact verification evidence, the approval receipt reviewed acknowledgements match that packet

when the review packet includes supplemental synthetic AEPX preservation proof evidence, the approval receipt reviewed acknowledgement matches that packet and the proof remains accepted_as_apply=false

when the review packet includes supplemental AEPX production-lane preflight evidence, the approval receipt reviewed acknowledgement matches that packet and the preflight remains accepted_as_apply=false
review packet report validation_status is review_ready
review packet report paths and binding checksum match request-pair manifest
review packet includes metadata-only downstream validate and generated JSX report bindings/digests
review packet includes generated JSX artifact digest metadata and does not embed the generated JSX body
if supplied, review packet generated JSX transaction artifact verification evidence proves path, byte count, and sha256 digest match the generated JSX transaction report
binding checksum matches request-pair manifest
request-pair manifest digest matches request-pair manifest
saved_output_path equals output_project_path
source_overwrite_observed is false
private_payloads_embedded is false
automated_oracle is false
accepted_is_not: permission to run AEX, OFX, or AviUtl core logic

non_goals: This closeout report does not launch After Effects.
This closeout report does not execute JSX.
This closeout report does not save projects.
This closeout report does not prove AE compatibility by itself.
This closeout report does not authorize source overwrite or direct binary .aep editing.
notes: The tool may emit only a not-run template with safe defaults.
An operator-filled closeout is evidence for a manual smoke attempt, not an automated oracle.

When the review packet includes optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification evidence, the closeout must preserve the matching reviewed acknowledgement from the approval receipt and still keep that verifier out of approval scope.

When the review packet includes optional standalone export artifact manifest or verification evidence, the closeout must preserve the same reviewed acknowledgements from the approval receipt and still keep those artifacts out of approval scope.

When the review packet includes optional synthetic AEPX preservation proof evidence, the closeout must preserve the matching reviewed acknowledgement and still treat the proof as local-fixture evidence only, not production AEPX apply permission.

When the review packet includes optional AEPX production-lane preflight evidence, the closeout must preserve the matching reviewed acknowledgement and still treat the preflight as gate-closed evidence only, not production AEPX apply or binary .aep editing permission.
Reports must not embed project XML, binary .aep payloads, layer text corpora, media, .ffx data, or .aex payloads.
